statement: The profile standardises the minimum metadata elements that health data holders are required to provide under the EHDS Regulation.
The profile remains fully compatible with DCAT-AP.
The profile aligns the minimum elements for open health data with those of DCAT-AP for High-Value Datasets.
The profile aligns the minimum elements for non-open, non-personal health data with the NSIP metadata of the Data Governance Act.
The profile defines stricter, conditional minimum element sets for protected and for sensitive (personal) health data.
The profile takes coded values (health themes, coding systems, code values, standards) as HTTP URIs from one shared, authoritative knowledge base (Wikidata).
The profile provides for data dictionaries in one harmonised machine-readable format (CSVW).
The profile provides for dataset descriptions in at least one official EU language.
The profile encourages data holders to create metadata in their native language.
Health data access bodies expose the national health catalogues through endpoints that the EU datasets catalogue, single information points and other catalogues can harvest.
Aggregating catalogues keep their copies of metadata linked to the original record at its source.
